text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. First, plan your tasks and set a realistic schedule. Prioritization is also important, so focus on the most urgent and important work first. When time is short, manage the scope: decide which tasks are essential and which can wait. Finally, communicate with your team or teacher early. If you see a problem, say so before it becomes serious. Clear communication helps others support you and reduces stress. With these simple habits, you can meet deadlines more calmly and produce better work.
